messages:
Eli: UmbraCare sent the network appendix. POC will hit our hosted API but compliance wants private connectivity. They asked whether PrivateLink or VPC peering is preferable, what firewall entries to open, and if we can provide stable IPs for allowlisting. Quick guidance?
Nora: Short: PrivateLink (AWS interface endpoint) is the fastest to stand up for a hosted-API POC. We can provision an endpoint and share the public EIPs bound to the endpoint ENIs for their allowlist. Caveat: AWS may move EIPs during maintenance. For guaranteed immutable IPs recommend peering or a Dedicated/private deployment.
Diego: Important: PrivateLink does NOT preserve original client source IPs once traffic reaches our backend; the backend sees the endpoint ENI IPs. If Umbra requires src-IP preservation for app ACLs, propose VPC peering or running Redwood in their account.
Hannah: They also said their proxy only allows SNI-based hostnames or IPs? Which do they prefer?
Eli: They said they prefer IP-only allowlists but will accept SNI if we can provide a hostname. They explicitly cannot do wildcard DNS allowlist.
Nora: Ok. If IP-only, we'll provision the endpoint and give them the EIP list. Provide them the change-ticket JSON snippet to paste.
Diego: Firewall snippet (CMDB JSON they can paste, replace dest with provided EIPs after provisioning):
```json
{"rule_name":"umbra->redwood-privatelink","direction":"egress","protocol":"tcp","ports":"443","destination":"<REPLACE_WITH_PROVIDED_EIP_OR_FQDN>","notes":"POC to Redwood PrivateLink endpoint. Replace destination with provided EIPs if IP-only policy."}
```
Nora: Also add these minimal network rules for path MTU and optional time sync:
- Allow ICMP type 3 (path MTU discovery)
- Allow UDP 123 -> NTP (optional)
- TLS SNI: privatelink.us-east-1.api.redwood-inference.internal if they accept SNI allowlisting

Eli: Pricing blurb for procurement: PrivateLink = AWS interface endpoint hourly + AWS data processing per-GB + our small connectivity surcharge. VPC peering = no endpoint hourly but potential cross-AZ data-transfer costs and more ops time. For quick POC PrivateLink usually lowest ops time.
Hannah: Security Q: mTLS? We support TLS 1.2/1.3 for hosted; mutual TLS is an enterprise feature for Dedicated/private deployments only. Recommend short-lived API keys for the POC and enable request-level logging in Console.
Diego: Operational note for sales: If they require both "IP-only immutable allowlist" and "preserve client source IP" that combination cannot be satisfied on hosted PrivateLink. Escalate to propose peering or a short Dedicated eval.
Eli: Action items: (1) ask Umbra if they accept post-provision EIP allowlist or insist on immutable IPs, (2) ask for estimated GB/day so we can estimate data processing costs, (3) if IP-only confirmed, infra to provision sandbox PrivateLink and we'll share EIPs.
infra-bot: Ticket NET-44770 created to provision sandbox PrivateLink in us-east-1 for UmbraCare POC. Owner: infra-oncall. ETA 48 hours.
Eli: Thanks team ":thumbsup:" I'll reply to Umbra and attach the JSON snippet.
Nora: If they push for immutable IP SLAs, escalate to me to discuss Dedicated/peering options.
